mentions.name: WhatsApp Habit-Building Chatbot
mentions.description: This WhatsApp chatbot helps people build better habits by suggesting a program of daily or weekly micro-goals for the habit the user wants to build. It sends user-configured reminders and check-ins to see whether users have completed their micro-goals. A beta test with about 20 users saw little uptake, so the project went back to the drawing board.
mentions.problem: People struggle to build better habits, and the initial product saw little uptake among beta users.
mentions.audience: People who want to build better habits.
mentions.source_excerpt: I was working on building a chatbot on WhatsApp - to help people build better habits. The bot would suggest a program consisting of daily/ weekly micro-goals for the habit the user wants to build. The bot also messages you with reminders ( set by user) and check-ins to see if users have completed their micro-goals.
